key_insight: Integral constraints can improve PINN accuracy by restoring uniform control over error components that the standard loss controls weakly in certain PDE parameter regimes.
engineering_relevance: Stability analysis can help identify when adding integrated governing equations to a PINN loss is likely to improve solution accuracy.
method: Derive stability estimates for several PDEs with and without integral constraints.
Compare how the losses control specific error components across parameter regimes.
Test the predicted accuracy differences in numerical experiments.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments show clear accuracy differences where standard-loss control is predicted to be weak, but similar accuracy where it remains sufficient.
watch_item: Benefits depend on the PDE and parameter regime; integral constraints are not a universal accuracy improvement.
paper_title: When and why can integral constraints improve the accuracy of physics-informed neural networks?
